summary: Deployment smoke test PASSED end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest smoke tests green (login OK, /api/auth/me OK, CRM tickets/categories/technicians/stats OK, topology entities+graph OK, notifications providers OK, no-auth returns 401). Frontend: login page renders, admin@noc.local / Admin@123 authenticates, token stored as noc_token in localStorage, redirected to '/', dashboard renders with stat cards (Pelanggan/Mitra/Dokumen/Rack&Device/Incident/Maintenance/Shift Handover), charts (recharts), sidebar navigation with all modules (Data Pelanggan, Mitra/Provider, Dokumen & Arsip, My DataCenter, Network, CRM Ticket Helpdesk, Operasional NOC, User & Hak Akses, Settings), and Aktivitas Terbaru feed. /topology route renders Leaflet GIS map with legend. No console errors, only benign recharts width/height(-1) warnings for offscreen chart containers.

issues: Multiple duplicated 'Selamat siang, Administrator' + timestamp strings visible in scrolling ticker/header row — appears intentional marquee but duplication looks noisy; low priority

Console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart containers rendered with 0 dims initially, likely when in collapsed/off-screen state. Cosmetic only, charts still render correctly once visible.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is large (1000+ lines). Consider splitting auth/seeding/dashboard endpoints into their own modules for maintainability (already partially modularized via include_router).
Recharts ResponsiveContainer parents missing explicit min-width/min-height — produces console warnings; add minWidth={0} minHeight={0} or fixed heights to silence.
test_credentials: admin@noc.local / Admin@123 (seeded, verified working; JWT stored under localStorage key 'noc_token')
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. App ships with seeded demo data (8 pelanggan, 6 mitra, 5 dokumen, 3 rack, incidents, shift handovers).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deployment verified. JWT auth key in localStorage is 'noc_token'. Backend routes all under /api. CRM router prefix is /api/crm. Topology has both /api/topology (v1) and topology_v2 routers. Public URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Smoke pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_smoke_deploy.py can be reused as a regression health-check. External integrations (WhatsApp Fonnte, SMTP, UISP, GenieACS, Zabbix) intentionally not configured — do not treat 'not connected' responses as bugs.
